FK labels name the parent table. Diagram arrows point to its primary key. Global Django auth infrastructure is excluded.

g.title: CharField selecting a reviewed application adapter, never executable user input.
JSONField, validated flags for push, face, fingerprint, card, commands, template export/import.
JSONField list of stable format/version codes.
password/hash field; never return the secret after enrollment.
CharField exactly as stored by the device.
BooleanField, default true; a per-enrollment master switch. False excludes punches under every device scope, even company_devices. Evaluate historical value at punch time.

BooleanField, default false; explicit permission for assigned_devices mode. Wider department/branch/company scopes do not require this flag. Creating an enrollment for recognition alone does not grant restricted-mode attendance permission.
FK -> Branch, PROTECT snapshot at receipt.
punch_batch, heartbeat, enrollment_result, command_result, device_info, unknown.
nullable CharField; set only from a trustworthy adapter identity.
nullable DateTimeField retaining the interpreted device time.
nullable BinaryField/private object reference for large payloads.
nullable vendor value; informational because it is not trusted.
JSONField/text snapshot of the individual source record.
authorized, unauthorized_device, unknown_employee, expired_enrollment, department_mismatch, branch_mismatch, enrollment_disabled, policy_unresolved.

JSONField containing the effective scope, winning policy level, effective evaluation time, historical enablement/grant results, and decision reason. These are frozen evaluation facts, not authoritative live relationships. Update resolution metadata only with an audited revision; never rewrite raw source values.
